title: Your settings moved to ~/.spec-control
summary: On its first start Spec Control moves its folder from `~/.openspec-dashboard/` to `~/.spec-control/`, worktrees included, and leaves a link at the old path so nothing that points there breaks. Set `SPEC_CONTROL_HOME` instead of `OPENSPEC_DASHBOARD_HOME`. Sessions that ended before the move may resume without their earlier conversation, for agents that remember conversations by folder.
